description: Search the ainews feed for items relevant to what your agent is about to do — technology, compliance, and security news for AI agents — ranked by relevance to your natural-language query. Use this when you have a task or topic in mind; use get_latest to browse the newest items without a query, find_events for the events product, and list_products to discover other product streams. Needs no API key.

limit.description: How many items to return; smaller values keep responses short.

product.description: Optional product stream to read (default ainews).

query.description: What your agent is doing or researching, in plain language; matched against item titles, summaries and tags. Example: "adding an MCP server to our coding agent" or "EU AI Act obligations for chatbots".

tags.description: Optional tags an item must all carry (AND), lowercase and hyphenated, e.g. ["mcp", "prompt-injection"] or ["advisory"]. Call get_latest without tags first if you don't know the vocabulary.

name: query_security_feed

summary.description: Short summary, or null when the item has not been enriched yet.

title: Query Security Feed
